// A Welford-style streaming accumulator. M2 is the running sum of squared
// deviations from the current mean; sample variance = M2 / (Count - 1).
type RunningStatistics
    implements IValue
{
    Count: Integer;
    Mean: Number;
    M2: Number;
}
